run_vit_flash_attn_wrapper: run vit_flash_attn_wrapper to compute flash attention with variable sequence lengths for ViT models
run_vit_triton_attn_wrapper: run vit_triton_attn_wrapper to compute triton-based attention for ViT models with cu_seqlens support
run_vit_torch_sdpa_wrapper: run vit_torch_sdpa_wrapper to compute scaled dot-product attention compatible with torch.compile
run_vit_flashinfer_wrapper: run vit_flashinfer_wrapper to compute flashinfer prefill attention with cudnn backend for ViT models
run_apply_sdpa: run apply_sdpa to compute scaled dot-product attention with optional GQA support on qkv tensors
